target_note: the sheet's 'Brix sum' column, which is the mean of the top/middle/bottom readings

excluded.no: identifier (kept separately as melon_id, not a feature)
excluded.Name: identifier - unique per melon, a model can memorise it
excluded.type: variety label - excluded by choice; the model predicts from what was measured, not from which variety it is
excluded.Brix top: component of the target - including it leaks the answer
excluded.Brix middle: component of the target - including it leaks the answer
excluded.Brix bottom: component of the target - including it leaks the answer
excluded.n_knocks: diagnostic: how many taps were detected, not a melon property
excluded.duration_s: diagnostic: length of the analysis window
excluded.clip_duration_s: diagnostic: how long you recorded for
excluded.rind_px: scale artefact: pixel area depends on camera distance
excluded.n_views: diagnostic: how many usable photos this melon had
excluded.stripe_width_sonya_only: blank for all 14 kinnaree melons (dark rind, no stripes found). Whether it is blank reveals the variety, so keeping it would leak type back in after type was dropped.

caveats: n=25: judge models by cross-validated error, never by training-set fit.
dominant_freq and mean_pitch estimate the same resonant frequency.
frequency features are confounded by melon size; no mass was recorded.
